headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when gold changed shoulders as the AEW TNT Title found a new champion as Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Wardlow battled it out in a Falls Count Anywhere match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.03 ? ending the champion's reign at 9 defenses. Wardlow was chasing gold for the 10th time. With Wardlow's gear and title stolen from his own rental car the night before, this personal Falls Count Anywhere brawl wrecked a Cadillac before QT Marshall's interference helped Hobbs win the TNT Title.
Looking back to 2025, when AEW welcomed Momo Watanabe for the first time against Serena Deeb, appearing on Collision, rated 6.92.

It was 2024 when Marq Quen chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a genuine milestone, facing Top Flight vs. Private Party vs. Keith & Komander, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 5.95 in a physical tag team battle.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2025, Hologram vs. Dralistico crossed paths for the first time ever on Collision, rated 7.51 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
Rewind to 2023, when Garcia, Guevara & Jericho made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.84.
Back on this day in 2025, Daniel Garcia vs. Lee Moriarty fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.24 ? a match that delivered.
